protocol.authorization: 用户已授权简单调度实现、真实验证、记录与G0评审；本次修复被受控反例证实的测量问题并新协议整12轮复验，不含发布或推送。
protocol.pre_registration_statement: 本v2协议在看到v1部分不利结果及迟发失败后登记，主张仅为修复测量链；此时尚未启动v2主性能采集。原始v1事前协议与全部结果保留，不冒称未见过结果。
protocol.seed_role: 批次标识；本轮不重新随机生成内容。原请求来自seed=20261020的冻结源轨迹。

trace_source.invariant: 保留源req_id、prompt、max_tokens、temperature及类别；交互到达点保留，只修改所选后台到达时间。

original.meaning: 同一修改后binary关闭策略，走原始队列路径

simple.meaning: 已有空slot时：最老已老化后台、最老交互、最老后台；非抢占、不预留slot

protocol.aging_role: 冻结的探索工程设置，不作参数搜索，不是后台完成SLO或最大等待保证。
protocol.cache_protocol: 每轮重启同一修改后binary；默认前缀缓存；原两条固定预热单列；记录prompt_n/cache_n、实际输出与finish_reason。
protocol.timing: 客户端同一time.monotonic：计划到达至首段非空生成内容为主；TCP连接后、HTTP写前至首内容为TTFT；建连计入迟发。服务内部等待仅用其自身时钟差。
protocol.primary_metric: completed interactive total_first_ms P95; linear interpolation, paired per-run contrast

exploratory_lines.interpretation: 逐对报告的探索观察线，非正式SLO、统计显著性或G0自动通过线；不要求三对全部通过，不宣称等效或复杂算法无用。

protocol.exclusions: Retain every v1/v2 run and unfavorable outcome. v2 uses same 50ms lag, capacity/version/terminal closure gates. Integrity failure pauses later runs; no result-based replacement, load adjustment, aged-threshold search or deletion.
protocol.limitations: 三对运行仅探索。原型不含完整硬KV账本、不抢占、不验证复杂在线校准；无收益仅限本条件与策略，不能证明复杂算法无用。
protocol.notes: v2 changes measurement persistence only. Workload, original/simple engine paths, aging5000, environment, order, windows and exploratory lines equal v1. All12 new runs, 2760 planned requests and24 separate warmups; no pooling with incomplete v1.
protocol.expected_persistence_mode: one async queue / serial worker-thread writes

measurement_repair.change: Per-request JSON/JSONL persistence moves from synchronous event-loop I/O to a single asynchronous queue and serial worker-thread writes; request timestamps/strategy/workload/thresholds unchanged.
measurement_repair.evidence_scope: Controlled artificial slow synchronous persistence can delay sends; not causal attribution of real-model negative policy results.
measurement_repair.required_v2_gate: 40/40 terminal closure, v2 artificial slow writes lag<=50ms and no late sends; cutoff timestamps <400ms for all8 unfinished, persistence drain separately accounted.
measurement_repair.persistence_rule: Record terminal and timestamps before persistence; wait for all request records to flush and fail the run on writer error; persistence drain excluded from model-completion denominator but reported separately.
measurement_repair.rerun_rule: Start all 12 runs anew under v2, never replace only an unfavorable simple run or pool v1 and v2 as paired repetitions.

v2_gate_observed.scope: Controlled sync persistence counterexample; does not explain actual model policy performance by itself

predecessor_batches.status_note: Incomplete previous session; preserve raw status and every partial/completed record. Completed original first-run P95=226.6044810499909ms, not a complete paired cohort.
Stopped after second run for fixed 50ms send-lag gate; both230 completed. Negative simple performance retained, not dismissed by gate failure.
